articles.summary: - Twelve academic and private clinical sites across the U.S. broaden patient access to the pivotal trial as Femasys advances FemBloc toward potential FDA approval - ATLANTA, Oct. 14, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - Femasys Inc. (NASDAQ: FEMY), a leading biomedical innovator developing transformative fertility and non-surgical permanent birth control solutions designed to improve the standard of care, expand access, and reduce costs for women worldwide, announced today that it has doubled the number of actively enrolling sites in its FemBloc ® FINALE Pivotal Trial to twelve across the United States. The coast-to-coast network of academic centers and private clinical practices now includes Baylor Research Institute and Columbia University Medical Center, joining existing academic sites Maimonides Medical Center, Stanford University, University of California Davis and the University of Utah.
